title: Group values under string keys in a multimap
summary: Insert 10,000 key-value pairs into a multimap that keeps every value of a key in order, remove 100 keys, then read the values of 500 keys.
notes: Every entry builds its multimap of 10,000 pairs inside the call, so insertion and growth are most of each figure; the 500 reads and 100 removals are the rest. Rust adapters copy each list they read into a new vector, because the map is dropped when the call returns. Rust allocation-counting overhead is included in CPU figures.
